evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality-cost objective.
